caseNameFull: Bank of Sturgeon v. Stanley Palmer
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Missouri.-
attorneys: Mr. Don C. Carter, with whom Mr. N. T. Gentry was on the brief, for plaintiff in error. Mr. Major J. Lilly, with whom Mr. James P. McBaine and Mr. Boyle G. Clark were on the brief, for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. § 237, Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
